conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hi, I’m trying to get an EMI moratorium for my home loan, but your website’s so confusing!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the trouble, ma’am. I can assist you with the moratorium process. Can you share your loan account number?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s eight eight, seven three, six zero, one eight, two four. I just need a break for a couple of months.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Got it. I’ll check your eligibility. It looks like you qualify for a 3-month moratorium. Would you like me to proceed?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yes, please! But will it affect my CIBIL score?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Good question. A moratorium won’t directly impact your CIBIL score, but interest will accrue. I’ll send you a detailed email with the terms.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: That’s a relief. Thanks for clearing that up!
